readerInvitation.closingInvitation: Begin with the missing half of technological history and the definition of social technology. Then follow how a familiar institution combines records, roles, incentives, and enforceable expectations. The full chronology supplies comparisons that a catalogue of inventions would leave disconnected. It helps readers ask which rules must change when a powerful new tool arrives. Read it to see the revisable social arrangements inside the technologies you already depend on.
